basic_info.description: Fully remodeled center-patio home seamlessly blends 1930s elegance with modern convenience. The bright main level features a formal living room with wood burning fireplace and custom windows mirroring the original design. Formal dining room opens to an Ipe decked center patio, the gourmet kitchen has been meticulously renovated to reflect the home's original 1930s charm while integrating modern functionality: Bosch convection oven/microwave, dishwasher and Sub Zero refrigeration. 2 spacious bedrooms overlook the lush garden and share an updated bathroom. The lower level was remodeled with permits, offering a bedroom overlooking the garden, family room with direct yard access, remodeled bathroom plus a den with Murphy bed. The landscaped east-facing backyard features a Studio-Shed perfect as an office or flex space. Energy-efficient upgrades: heat pump, solar with battery backup, full-home insulation, smart thermostats and upgraded double-pane windows throughout. One-car garage equipped w/ electric car charging plug. The garage door mural is a replica and homage to the infamous Fairmont Hotel's Tonga room! Centrally located near Noriega Street shops, restaurants, and public transportation, this home offers the perfect blend of style, comfort, & sustainability in a prime location
